sources.note: The Mandarin: the digital Opal card/wallet trial was quietly discontinued (2023); no native Opal card in Apple Wallet.
Transport for NSW contactless payments page: riders pay with Apple Pay (incl. Express Mode) on Opal readers — open-loop contactless, not a provisioned Opal card in Wallet.
Wikipedia: Opal Next Gen (Opal 2.0) targeting rollout around 2028; no native Apple Wallet pass available as of August 2026.
NeatPass 2026 guide confirms no Opal card in Apple Wallet; open-loop Apple Pay with Express Transit remains the only iPhone-based tap option on the Opal network.
